`SIFR-PYENV-0005` belongs to the **Embedded CPython environment** diagnostic family. It means: selected Python interpreter is not supported CPython.

## Why It Happens

The selected Python environment is missing, malformed, ambiguous, or fails probe/ABI checks. Configure exactly one root-application uv environment and ensure the interpreter, site-packages, and declared imports are available.

<Info>
Use `sifr --explain SIFR-PYENV-0005` locally to see the renderer's exact message template and any machine-applicable suggestions for the compiler version you are running.
</Info>
